source_excerpt: What IF Web is a Christchurch, New Zealand-based boutique studio serving SaaS, tech, and SMB clients with web development and AI search optimization.
observation: What IF Web is an independent creative studio in Christchurch, New Zealand, founded by Isaac Farrow and a design co-founder with a team of 3-5 staff, offering web development and AI search optimization to SMB and tech clients.
interpretation: Establishes an active micro-agency matching the GEO-AGENCY-01 profile (2-20 staff, independent, English-speaking, recurring SMB client engagements).

source_excerpt: Clients noticed organic traffic erosion even when retaining top 10 rankings because Google AI Overviews intercepted clicks. Prompt sets are built collaboratively with clients based on sales call language.
observation: Clients triggered the workflow after noticing organic traffic erosion from Google AI Overviews. The agency co-founder builds prompt sets collaboratively with clients using sales conversation language, and uses Otterly.ai to test citability and crawlability across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.
interpretation: Confirms the workflow trigger is client traffic erosion and executive curiosity, the operator is a hands-on co-founder/developer, inputs are client sales prompts, and core review involves crawlability and citability checks.

source_excerpt: We don't sell traffic and we don't sell leads. We sell citability across the tracked prompt set we work out with the client. Post-report actions include profile consistency on directories like Clutch and prompt-led content.
observation: The client deliverable is packaged as a Health Check plus Monthly Retainer reporting citability and competitor citation share, deliberately rejecting traffic guarantees. Post-report actions include directory entity consistency (Clutch profile alignment), robots/sitemap cleanup, and prompt-targeted blog content.
interpretation: Demonstrates that the client deliverable is framed as citability and competitor share of voice rather than traffic guarantees, leading to actions like off-page entity cleanup and prompt-answering content.

source_excerpt: SORN.AI is an independent AI SEO agency offering technical SEO, content, and generative engine optimization across SaaS, e-commerce, cybersecurity, and legal.
observation: SORN.AI is an independent boutique agency serving SaaS, ecommerce, cybersecurity, and legal clients with technical SEO, content architecture, and generative engine optimization.
interpretation: Establishes a verifiable boutique SEO agency in the 2-10 staff range offering recurring GEO monitoring services to SMB and growth clients.

source_excerpt: SEO & GEO Strategist Stanislava Smiljanic handles prompt modeling and content architecture; triggers include client growth plateaus and pre-sales pitch audits. Review includes crawlability and entity resolution.
observation: The operator is an SEO/GEO Strategist; triggers include client growth plateaus and pre-sales prospect gap audits. Review includes crawler access verification, entity resolution checks, ICP prompt modeling, and auditing content for concise prompt answers and HTML comparison tables.
interpretation: Shows that the operator is a dedicated SEO strategist or agency co-founder, triggers encompass recurring retention reviews and pre-sales pitch audits, and reviews focus on crawlability, entity clarity, and table structure.

source_excerpt: Reports are delivered on a weekly cadence because AI citations fluctuate rapidly. Key deliverables include Brand Visibility Index quadrant charts against competitors and Search Console graphs.
observation: Client reporting is conducted on a weekly cadence using Brand Visibility Index quadrant graphs comparing the client against 4 named competitors and tracking citation share. Post-report actions include inverted article introductions, custom FAQ schema markup, and off-page citation acquisition.
interpretation: Demonstrates weekly recurrence driven by rapid AI answer volatility, with reports focusing on competitor benchmarking and deliverables tied directly to FAQ schema and on-page rewriting.

source_excerpt: Butter Marketing is an agency with 2-9 employees in London, UK, focusing 70% of its service on Generative Engine Optimization for SMB clients.
observation: Butter Marketing is verified on Clutch with a team size of 2-9 employees based in London, UK, allocating 70% of its service focus to Generative Engine Optimization alongside traditional SEO for SMB service and eCommerce clients.
interpretation: Validates a micro-agency (2-9 employees) matching GEO-AGENCY-01 that establishes GEO as its primary service line.

source_excerpt: Dedicated GEO Plan at $399/mo includes monthly AI prompt testing and indexing strategy, 1 AI-crawlable content citation, Knowledge graph submissions, Schema markup, and monthly delivery reporting.
observation: Butter Marketing publicly sells a dedicated GEO Plan for $399 per month (including monthly AI prompt testing/indexing, 1 AI-crawlable content citation, schema markup guidance, monthly reporting) and a combined GEO+SEO Plan for $699 per month.
interpretation: Confirms small agencies package monthly recurring GEO monitoring and reporting into standalone retainer tiers ($399-$699/month) for SMB clients.

source_excerpt: Embarque has 10-49 employees on Clutch, specializing in SEO and Generative Engine Optimization for SaaS startups and software SMBs.
observation: Embarque is listed on Clutch with a team size of 10-49 employees (~12-20 core staff), specializing in SEO and Generative Engine Optimization for SaaS startups and software SMBs, with project minimums starting at $1,000.
interpretation: Establishes an independent small agency serving software SMBs on recurring retainers with explicit GEO offerings.

source_excerpt: Offers systematic AI citation audits across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, AI Overviews, entity schema implementation, and dedicated AI citation tracking dashboards.
observation: Embarque's GEO service offering includes systematic AI citation audits across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews, entity and schema implementation, and dedicated AI citation tracking dashboards for ongoing client monitoring.
interpretation: Shows small agencies utilize dedicated AI citation dashboards and multi-model audits as regular client deliverables.

source_excerpt: Clutch lists thousands of SEO agencies with filters for team size (2-9, 10-49 employees), service lines including GEO, client reviews, and direct links to agency websites.
observation: Clutch hosts public listings of thousands of SEO agencies with searchable filters for team size ('2-9 employees', '10-49 employees'), service line ('Generative Engine Optimization', 'SEO'), verified client reviews referencing reporting, and direct links to agency websites and founders.
interpretation: Validates Clutch as a high-confidence, legitimate public discovery channel for identifying target agency budget owners and heads of SEO in the 2-20 employee bracket.

source_excerpt: Without a specialized tool, tracking prompts would be very manual, with a ton of print screens and manual research of prompts with VPN.
observation: SEO strategist Stanislava Smiljanic stated that without specialized tooling, monitoring AI visibility across prompts required 'a ton of print screens and manual research of prompts with VPN', which is unsustainable across multiple clients.
interpretation: Identifies the incumbent manual alternative (VPN + manual prompting + screenshot collection) and establishes the operational friction that drives agencies to seek automated multi-client solutions.

source_excerpt: Peec AI pricing: Essential at 175 EUR/mo, Growth at 365 EUR/mo (3-10 clients), Scale at 575 EUR/mo (11-25+ clients). Features pitch projects, shareable client dashboards, cloned Looker Studio templates.
observation: Peec AI provides agency-specific features including pitch project audits, shareable client dashboards, cloned Looker Studio templates, and multi-client plans priced at 175 EUR/mo (Essential), 365 EUR/mo (Growth: 3-10 clients), and 575 EUR/mo (Scale: 11-25+ clients) covering ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini, and AI Overviews.
interpretation: Documents a direct commercial alternative designed for agency multi-client monitoring and Looker Studio client reporting, setting a price reference of 365 EUR/month for small agencies (3-10 clients).

source_excerpt: Traditional SEO suites track Google AI Overviews in SERPs but lack tracking for conversational chatbot engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity standalone, or Claude.
observation: Traditional SEO suites like Semrush track Google AI Overviews within existing keyword position trackers ($139-$499/mo), but lack tracking for conversational chatbot engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity standalone, Claude, or Gemini apps, requiring agencies to use separate workflows for conversational AI.
interpretation: Shows that incumbent SEO tool suites solve only the SERP AI Overview part of the workflow, leaving a gap for conversational AI monitoring that agencies must address separately.

source_excerpt: Otterly provides a native Google Looker Studio connector enabling automated export of prompt tracking data and citation visibility into custom dashboards.
observation: Otterly.ai provides a native Google Looker Studio connector that enables agencies to export prompt tracking data, brand citation rates, and competitor share of voice directly into customized, white-label client dashboards.
interpretation: Demonstrates that Looker Studio is the primary mechanism through which agencies integrate automated AI visibility metrics into branded client deliverables.
